 Sajid Raza Updated: Nov 4, 2026, 07:22 IST Andhra Pradesh school holiday: Schools to remain closed on November 4 and 5 for MPTC, ZPTC elections The Andhra Pradesh government has announced that elections for Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituency (MPTC) and Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) are coming up and the government has declared holiday on November 4 and 5, 2026.
 Polling will be Nov. 5 and vote counting will be Nov. 7.
 The order applies to government offices, private buildings and educational institutions related to the polling process. The State Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department has instructed officials to take the required measures to put the order into action and to ensure that the elections take place smoothly.
 AP MPTC, ZPTC Elections 2026: Holiday details 
 November 4 has been designated for polling preparations and November 5 is the main polling day. 
 The arrangement is designed to facilitate the rural local body elections, while also enabling authorities to make the necessary arrangements.
 However, the holiday order applies to establishments connected with the election process, as mentioned in the report. Staff and students are advised to refer to the relevant guidance provided by their institution and/or department.
 AP MPTC, ZPTC election 2026 dates 
 The Andhra Pradesh MPTC and ZPTC election schedule includes the following important dates:
 November 4, 2026: Holiday for polling arrangements
 November 5, 2026: MPTC and ZPTC polling
 November 7, 2026: Vote counting
 The elections are the next stage in the state's local body electoral schedule, following the completion of municipal elections. 
 Election preparations are underway across the districts covered by the polling process.
 MPTC, ZPTC Elections: Number of seats and nominations 
 The final nomination figures highlight the scale of the Andhra Pradesh rural local body elections.
 Election Seats Nominations 
 MPTC 9,829 46,045 
 ZPTC 659 4,770 
 There are 46,045 nominations for 9,829 MPTC seats in 28 districts in the final list. A total of 4770 nominations have been received for 659 seats in the ZPTC elections so far.
 Polling is being organised in the constituencies as per the election schedule by the election authorities. 
 The counting of votes will finish on November 7th.
 What voters should know
 The voters who cast their votes in the AP MPTC and ZPTC elections should review their polling information and adhere to instructions from election officials. Schools and other government agencies and private entities associated with polling should also observe related holidays.
 The holiday on November 4 and 5 have been declared to assist in the preparation for elections and boost participation in the local body elections taking place in Andhra Pradesh in rural areas.
